name: for-landing
description: Operator intent: run basic PR processing toward merge (conflicts, reviews, CI)

name: for-review
description: Operator intent: landing processing plus a second quality, security, and performance review pass (higher priority than for-landing)

name: for-impl
description: Operator intent: implement this issue and open a linked PR (requires watch_issues)

name: duplicate
description: Hold: suspected duplicate; verify patch equivalence and base containment before closing

name: merge:ready
description: merge-god may process or embark this PR

name: merge:processing
description: merge-god is actively processing this PR

name: merge:embarked
description: merge-god included this PR in an embark cohort

name: merge:blocked
description: merge-god is blocked and needs human input or external state

name: merge:failed
description: merge-god processing failed

name: merge:complete
description: merge-god completed processing for this PR

name: remediation:observe-only
description: Gather evidence only; do not run mutating remediation

name: remediation:validate-only
description: Run validation and report fixes without changing the branch

name: remediation:mechanical-fixes
description: Allow bounded generated, formatting, and mechanical fixes

name: remediation:bounded-fixes
description: Allow fixes that preserve the PR's retained scope

name: remediation:maintainer-approved
description: Allow broader remediation after verified maintainer approval

name: large
description: Agent annotation: broad PR with many files or substantial review surface

name: too-large
description: Agent annotation: PR is too large to safely process as one landing unit

name: unaligned
description: Agent annotation: implementation appears unaligned with design, requirements, or merge rules

name: needs-split
description: Agent annotation: PR should be split into smaller or underlying PRs

name: needs-ci
description: Agent annotation: CI or validation failures need remediation

name: needs-rebase
description: Agent annotation: PR needs to be updated from its base branch

name: needs-conflict-resolution
description: Agent annotation: PR needs merge conflict resolution

name: needs-review
description: Agent annotation: PR needs review feedback addressed or approval

name: needs-design
description: Agent annotation: design or requirements clarification is needed before landing

name: high-risk
description: Agent annotation: higher merge risk due to scope, architecture, or validation uncertainty

name: low-risk
description: Agent annotation: low-risk change with narrow scope

name: docs-only
description: Agent annotation: documentation-only change

name: test-only
description: Agent annotation: test-only change

name: embark-candidate
description: Agent annotation: candidate for grouped embark validation

name: underlying-needed
description: Agent annotation: needs an underlying remediation PR or set before landing
